rule: P6 / §8.3 'every Latin/number token in <bdi>' (hard rule: every Latin/number token inside a Hebrew line in <bdi dir="ltr">)
defect: The <dd> values are only bdi-wrapped for en-dash ranges (via elmsnest-v2-bdi-range) and for the fixed code list IP68..220V (lines 210-215). Against the real bullets this (a) splits tokens: 'סוללה 800mAh' (waterproof-solar-deck-step-lights) and '1200mAh' (magnetic-rechargeable-touch-wall-light) become '800<bdi dir="ltr">mAh</bdi>' - the EN run and the isolate reorder in the RTL line and the shopper reads 'mAh800' (un-wrapped, '800mAh' was already correct); (b) leaves number+unit pairs unfixed: '54 LED' (rechargeable-telescopic-camping-lantern spec run) still displays 'LED 54' with or without the LED wrap; (c) leaves '12×2' / '6×4' (decorative-led-net-lights bullets) bare - × is neutral between two EN runs, so they display as '2×12' / '4×6'. Only whole-token isolation (the v2-terms loop, sections/elmsnest-v2-terms.liquid:39-55) fixes all three.
fix:
Replace lines 207-216 with a whole-token wrap, then merge adjacent wrapped tokens, then run the range isolator: {%- liquid
  assign latin_chars = '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
  assign words = f[1] | strip | split: ' '
  assign v = ''
  for w in words
    assign c = w | slice: 0, 1
    if c != blank and latin_chars contains c
      assign tok = '<bdi dir="ltr">' | append: w | append: '</bdi>'
    else
      assign tok = w
    endif
    if forloop.first
      assign v = tok
    else
      assign v = v | append: ' ' | append: tok
    endif
  endfor
  assign v = v | replace: '</bdi> <bdi dir="ltr">', ' '
-%}
{%- capture v -%}{%- render 'elmsnest-v2-bdi-range', text: v -%}{%- endcapture -%}
{%- assign v = v | strip | replace: '<bdi>', '<bdi dir="ltr">' -%}  (drop the `for code in latin` replace loop; the `latin` list at line 41 stays for the IP-giant detection only). Result: '800mAh', '54 LED', '12×2', 'AC 85–265V', 'CE, RoHS, UL, FCC, LVD' each sit in ONE ltr isolate; 'כ־8–10 שעות' keeps its range bdi; '6W או 12W' becomes two isolates around the Hebrew word.

rule: §8.2.5 'nothing otherwise' / snippet's own comment line 7 'the container is not rendered at all'
defect: The gate only tests that an option named «כמות» (or containing «אורך») exists, not that any variant produces a line. powerful-solar-garden-light has «כמות» = «יחידה אחת» only, so the PDP gets an always-empty <div class="ens-unit"> (margin -4px 0 10px) plus a dead script - a 6 px stray gap under the price and a container that contradicts the comment.
fix:
Before line 26 pre-compute a flag over product.variants (same parsing as lines 40-62, no output): {%- liquid
  assign ens_any = false
  for ens_v in product.variants
    if ens_len_i > -1
      assign ens_raw = ens_v.options[ens_len_i] | default: '' | strip
      assign ens_m = ens_raw | split: 'מ' | first | strip | plus: 0
      if ens_m > 0
        assign ens_any = true
      endif
    elsif ens_qty_i > -1
      assign ens_raw = ens_v.options[ens_qty_i] | default: '' | strip
      assign ens_q = ens_raw | split: ' ' | first | plus: 0
      if ens_raw == 'זוג'
        assign ens_q = 2
      endif
      if ens_q > 1
        assign ens_any = true
      endif
    endif
  endfor
-%} and change line 26 to {%- if ens_any -%}.

rule: P6 '44 px tap targets' (elmsnest-s-contact §5.4 implements it for its text link via ::before; the two other in-form text links do not)
defect: a.ens-kicker__link is a 13 px inline link with a ~20 px hit box (line-height 1.5); the contact link in the same buy box gets a 44 px hit area through a ::before pseudo-element, this one does not.
fix: Line 18: add position:relative to the a.ens-kicker__link rule and append the rule `.ens-kicker__link::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-block:-12px;inset-inline:-6px}` (same technique as snippets/elmsnest-s-contact.liquid:29).

defect: a.ens-terms-line__link («לכל התנאים ←») is a 13 px inline-block link ~21 px tall with no enlarged hit area, unlike the contact link rendered two blocks below it.
fix: Line 18: add position:relative to the a.ens-terms-line__link rule and append `.ens-terms-line__link::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-block:-12px;inset-inline:-6px}`.

rule: §10 'the s-pdp-* snippets read only product, collection, shop, routes' (letter of the rule)
defect: The kicker resolves the matched handle through the global `collections` object (collections[ens_kicker_handle]). It works in a _liquid block (only section/settings are unavailable there) and it is what snippets/elmsnest-s-place.liquid:9 tells callers to do, but it is a fifth object outside the list the spec allows for these snippets. Reading the collection off `product.collections` keeps the snippet inside the rule with no behaviour change.
fix: Replace line 14 with: {%- assign ens_kicker_coll = blank -%}{%- for ens_c in product.collections -%}{%- if ens_c.handle == ens_kicker_handle -%}{%- assign ens_kicker_coll = ens_c -%}{%- break -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}  (line 7 comment: drop 'and the global `collections`'). If the lead treats `collections` as allowed, dismiss this item.
